course_name_original: UE Structures classiques d'électronique de puissance

learning_outcomes.text: Present the main and/or most pedagogical power electronics structures (choppers, isolated DC/DC power supplies, single-phase rectifiers, single-phase inverters, and dimmers).
Analyze the operation of a converter structure: Deduce the operation from the control law (be able to determine the waveforms).
Deduce the relationship between the input and output of a static converter.
Perform initial sizing of semiconductors and filtering elements.

institution: Institut National Polytechnique De Grenoble — Licence Électronique-Énergie électrique-Automatique (UGA)
degree: Licence Électronique, énergie électrique, automatique, parcours EEA (2e et 3e année)
